title: Tera Veer Vichora Lay Aaya Teri Bhain
body:
Tera veer vichora lay aaya teri bhain nu tor kay raahwaa’n tay..
Sani)
Aena safraan da mull pay jaway jay shakal Raza teri waikh lawa aetbar reya nahin sahwaa’n da..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Akhiyan band howan tou pehlay aa ja veeran
Main Fatima bint e Kazim haan ek qaidi baap di bachri nu lakh maan nay teriyan bahwaan tay..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Teray dardaan day nal wabasta jaan meri
Kae zakham aaye meray payraa tay teray ek deedar lae veeran rul gae anjaan main thaawaa’n tay..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Watna toun turr pae main lay kay naal judaeyaan nu
Her qadam tay veer talash kita tera chehra wich pardesa day meray reh gaye maan duwawan tay..
<<DIVIDER>>
Antra)
Labdi rae aa’n main hujat tamam main ker chori
Karay vayn Samar Masooma e Qum main mar jaawa per shikwa nahin teray gham vich veer qazawaa’n da..
